product.title: Drape Skirt 18
product.description: The Drape Skirt 18 Chandelier consists of 18 individual pendants gathered into 6 groups of 3 and supported by a series of 6 brass “skirt” structures arranged around the circumference of a brass ring. The brass “skirts” attach to the ring by a series of simple slotted connections, allowing the “skirts” to hold the ring with the slight friction of the cords passing through the smooth brass tubes of the “skirts”. Each pendant features a 4.5"/110mm diameter diffuser of handblown Czech glass suspended on a fabric-wrapped electrical cord. The glass diffusers are available in both "dipped" glass, featuring the SkLO double-dipped flame-polished mouth and "textured" glass, featuring a soft, frosted finish and subtle sculpted vertical ridges. Cord lengths are field adjustable.
